compiled_state.title: Fix test-review-gate-bypass-sentinel.sh: set WORKFLOW_CONFIG_FILE=local before sourcing hook
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
This task satisfies:
- DD4: Unit tests written and passing for any new logic

## Description

After flipping enforcement.strategy=ci in .claude/dso-config.conf, the existing
bypass-sentinel tests (which test blocking behavior like --no-verify) fail because
the enforcement gate reads the real config (ci) and short-circuits all calls to
hook_review_bypass_sentinel() before any pattern matching can occur.

Fix: In tests/hooks/test-review-gate-bypass-sentinel.sh, before sourcing
review-gate-bypass-sentinel.sh, set WORKFLOW_CONFIG_FILE to a temp config with
enforcement.strategy=local. This ensures the enforcement gate captures local
strategy at source time, preserving the test-time assumption that blocking is active.

The subprocess-based tests (test_sentinel_allows_noverify_under_ci_strategy etc.)
are unaffected — they already manage their own WORKFLOW_CONFIG_FILE via
call_sentinel_with_config().

### Change required

Near the top of tests/hooks/test-review-gate-bypass-sentinel.sh, after the source
statements but BEFORE sourcing review-gate-bypass-sentinel.sh:

```bash
# Set enforcement strategy to local for test isolation.
# Without this, enforcement-gate.sh reads the real dso-config.conf at source time.
# When enforcement.strategy=ci, hook_review_bypass_sentinel() returns 0 immediately,
# breaking all block tests. Each test that needs ci behavior uses call_sentinel_with_config().
_TEST_ISOLATION_DIR=$(mktemp -d /tmp/sentinel-test-isolation.XXXXXX)
printf 'enforcement.strategy=local\n' > "$_TEST_ISOLATION_DIR/dso-config.conf"
WORKFLOW_CONFIG_FILE="$_TEST_ISOLATION_DIR/dso-config.conf"
trap 'rm -rf "$_TEST_ISOLATION_DIR"' EXIT
```

Then source review-gate-bypass-sentinel.sh AFTER setting WORKFLOW_CONFIG_FILE.

### Verification
After the fix, run:
bash tests/hooks/test-review-gate-bypass-sentinel.sh
Expected: 49 passed, 0 failed

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] All 49 bypass-sentinel tests pass
  Verify: bash tests/hooks/test-review-gate-bypass-sentinel.sh 2>&1 | grep -E "PASSED|FAILED"
- [ ] WORKFLOW_CONFIG_FILE set to local config before sourcing sentinel in test file
  Verify: grep -q 'WORKFLOW_CONFIG_FILE.*dso-config.conf' tests/hooks/test-review-gate-bypass-sentinel.sh
